messages:
Ava (PM): Heads-up: execs want a tighter MVP for an upcoming pilot. We need a 10-day slimship plan. What are non-negotiables?
Marcus (Eng): Core inference API, chat sessions, and API keys are non-negotiable. Everything else can be deferred.
Lina (Design): UX: keep core chat and history. Admin settings and analytics can be placeholder screens linking to docs.
Priya (Eng-Infra): we can save deployment time by using reduced batch sizes + a feature-flagged quantized model for the pilot. Requires a short QA gate.
Zoë (QA): QA gate: 2 regression suites (functionality + quality) and a 50-query eval. ETA 3 days.
Eli (Sales): Pilot customer is fine with minimal admin if we communicate limits. They care about reliability more than features.
Ava (PM): Proposal: cut tenant analytics, RBAC UI, and quant toggle to v1. Ship with scoped tokens (API-only) and quantized pilot path behind FF. Timeline impact: +6d net. Agree?
Marcus (Eng): agreed. I'll add rollback switch and monitor token cost.
Priya (Eng-Infra): I'll add alerts for cost & latency and provision pilot infra.
Ava (PM): Great. I'll update milestone tracker, notify pilots, and file cutlist. Add risks in thread.
Marcus (Eng): risk: higher token cost on quant path; monitor.
Zoë (QA): risk: small increase in hallucinations; QA to validate.
thread_preview: Team agrees a 10-day slimship: defer admin/analytics to v1, use quantized pilot path behind feature flag, keep core inference and scoped tokens, add QA gate and monitoring.
